reference: Original 1999 THPS Mall: supplied VGCartography cutaway and original PS1 gameplay
scope: Reference-derived geometry validated with the existing skater. Corrects the first-island round planter to the source oval bench, lengthens its approach deck, and relocates the first escalator, adjacent trough and directory. Eight native-input routes, both bench grind directions and the actual-spawn fast loop pass. No shared runtime or movement tuning edits. Absolute source dimensions, the upper exit passage and remaining architectural fidelity are not yet verified.
